honing_confound: Igniter's burst ceiling scales with Spell Power (a stat derived from gear honing). Identity activation frequency depends on Cinder/Ignition meter fill rate from skill usage, which is faster at higher cast speed (Swiftness). Tier standing reflects high burst ceiling class that is increasingly favored at T4 honing peaks.

delivery.evidence: Primary damage skills are targeted spell casts: Blaze, Meteor, Inferno, Punishing Strike. Punishing Strike is a telegraphed ground AoE. Meteor is a targetted falling impact. Blaze is an on-location fire zone. All ranged from the caster's position.

footprint.evidence: Sorceress skills are among the widest AoE in the game. Inferno covers a large ground zone. Blaze creates a persistent fire zone. Meteor is a large-radius impact. Punishing Strike creates a wide AoE ground marker. Sorceress is the premier AoE mage.

geo_text: Long-range spell caster with large AoE footprints. Igniter Sorceress places large ground zones and fires targeted spells at boss positions from safe range. Caster is stationary during major casts (rooted) but engages from ~20-30m range. The identity management layer (Cinder/Ignition) is invisible spatially — it manifests as a change in skill amplification during the Ignition window.

control.evidence: Some Sorceress skills apply knockback (Punishing Strike). Frost-type skills (Frost's Call, Blizzard) apply Slow. Control is a rider on a damage-primary kit — Sorceress does not build around CC. Igniter specifically deprioritizes CC in favor of pure damage output.

defense.evidence: Sorceress is the most fragile class in the game — no armor type defense (Mage robes). Blink skill (S key spacebar variant) is the primary defensive tool (teleport dodge). Igniter removes one use of the Blink-equivalent identity tool (Ignition replaces one blink slot with the burst mode). Glass cannon archetype.

economy.resource_verbatim: Cinder Meter (Identity Gauge — fills via skill damage dealt)
economy.builder_source: All skills fill Cinder Meter proportional to damage dealt. Big spells fill more Cinder. No dedicated 'builder' skill — all offensive skills generate Cinder as a passive fill mechanism.
economy.plain_text: Cinder fills via dealing damage. When full, choose identity spend: (A) Blink (double teleport dodge — positional escape) or (B) Ignition (Z key) = enter Ignition state. In Ignition: next spells gain massive damage amplification; Ignition drains Cinder over time. IGNITER IDENTITY: Ignition state amplification is significantly enhanced vs non-Igniter. The meta is to save Cinder for Ignition burst windows rather than spending on Blink. Trade: survival tool (Blink) for burst window (Ignition).

element.evidence: Sorceress has two elemental tracks: fire skills (Blaze, Meteor, Flame Hurricane) and arcane/lightning skills (Rime Arrow, Punishing Strike, Thunderbolt). Damage mode is 'hit' for most; Blaze creates a persistent DoT zone (hybrid). Igniter specifically amplifies fire-track skills in community practice (Meteor as primary burst skill).

movement.evidence: Sorceress is rooted during all major spell casts (the tradeoff for their range). Blink (spacebar) = teleport-dodge. Igniter identity deprioritizes Blink usage — creates tension between survival and burst optimization. Lowest physical mobility in the game during cast animations.

attr.evidence: Sorceress is the premier long-range class. Primary engagement from safe distance. Ground-targeted AoE lands far from caster.

range.evidence: Sorceress spells have among the longest effective ranges in LA — ground targeted at 20-30m. Blaze and Inferno have long throw range. Punishing Strike marks the ground far from caster.

tempo.evidence: Igniter is the burst identity: Cinder meter management is about SAVING for Ignition windows rather than spending on Blink. The burst phase (Ignition state) is the identity. Between windows: build Cinder.

amp.value: Ignition state: massive spell damage amplification (2-3× modifier on key spells during window)
amp.evidence: Community guides confirm Igniter provides significantly higher burst ceiling than Reflux. Exact multipliers in current Ark Passive system not verified from live sources — conf 0.8.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics. All damage is direct spell casting.

commitment.evidence: Inferno (the signature Igniter skill) is a long channel (holds while channeling). Blaze is a placed zone that requires setup positioning. Meteor has a cast time. Major skills all require stationary commitment.

mechanics_notes: 1) Igniter is the highest-ceiling burst mage in LA — its design philosophy is 'endure the difficult glass-cannon positioning for a devastating burst window.' No other class punishes misplay so harshly (dies in 1-2 hits from boss attacks without Blink) or rewards it so well (top-3 DPS in competent hands). 2) The Cinder/Blink tension is a signature design: Sorceress must choose between spending identity resource on survival vs offense. Igniter identity resolves this tension by making Ignition the correct choice, reducing Blink usage to emergencies only. 3) Reflux (contrast): Reflux disables Ignition and refunds Cinder passively — the identity tool becomes unavailable and skills gain reduced cooldowns instead. Igniter and Reflux represent two completely opposite philosophies about the identity resource. 4) SORCERESS IS THE GENRE-CANONICAL GLASS CANNON MAGE — the archetype referenced in game design discussions as the epitome of burst/fragility tradeoff. Corpus value: highest in genre for this archetype.
stabilization_patch: Igniter was the dominant Sorceress identity from late 2022 when the identity system was tuned for burst performance. A November 2022 patch specifically strengthened Igniter's Ignition window — community identified this as the 'Igniter meta-defining' moment.
tier_standing_current: S/A-tier (community consensus 2024-2026; Sorceress S-tier in Manillagames January 2026 list). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Igniter's tier placement reflects T4 burst ceiling; raw output is competitive but positional risk is punishing in tight raid mechanics.

honing_confound: Reflux's sustained output relies on Crit rate and Swiftness stat (cast speed). Swiftness scales with gear honing. Tier standing reflects consistent DPS profile at all tiers — less honing-dependent than Igniter's burst ceiling.

geo_text: Same long-range large-AoE spatial identity as Igniter. The spatial difference is behavioral: Reflux has BLINK available (Ignition disabled) which means better ability to reposition between skills. Reflux Sorceress maintains consistent spell output from range without building to a burst window.

Key difference: Reflux RETAINS Blink usage (Ignition is disabled) — so Reflux has better survival than Igniter because the Cinder meter is freely spent on Blink rather than saved for Ignition. 'Prevents using one of your identity skills and focuses on blink to position better.'

economy.builder_source: N/A in Reflux — Cinder is spent freely on Blink since Ignition is disabled. Reflux 'prevents using one of your identity skills' (Ignition). Skills have reduced cooldowns as compensation.
economy.plain_text: REFLUX IDENTITY: Ignition (burst mode) is DISABLED. Cinder meter fills passively and is spent freely on Blink (teleport-dodge). ALL SKILLS gain reduced cooldowns — making Reflux a true 'rotation-less' class where any available skill is used based on situation. The resource model shifts from METER (save for burst) to COOLDOWN (use when available). No rotation discipline required; high flexibility but lower peak burst.

element.evidence: Same as Igniter. Reverse Gravity is Arcane-type.

movement.evidence: Same rooted-during-cast but Reflux has BETTER effective mobility because Blink is available as a survival tool (not saved for Ignition). 'Focuses on blink to position better' — Blink is the Reflux identity's mobility enabler.

tempo.evidence: Reflux is the sustained identity: no burst windows, consistent spell output throughout fight. 'Rotation-less class' — skills fire as cooldowns allow. Even damage output with no peak/valley rhythm.

amp.value: All skills: reduced cooldowns (Reflux identity effect). Reverse Gravity: 'overflowing energy' tripod provides significant damage boost as Reflux-exclusive trigger.
amp.evidence: Search results confirm reduced cooldowns as the core Reflux mechanic. New Reverse Gravity tripod effect is 2024-2025 balance change per search.

commitment.evidence: Skills are faster to cycle in Reflux due to reduced cooldowns, so the effective commitment is shorter per skill. But individual cast animations are the same as Igniter — still rooted during casting.
